name: qlrisk_price_commodity_option
title: Price a CommodityOption
description:
Price one Commodity Option (qlrisk CommodityOption): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), notional (amount; default 1000000), option_type (call/put; default call), strike, quantity, commodity (default WTI), convenience_yield_pct (percent, 3 = 3%; default 0), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, spot, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 121,749.11 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
